signals.summary: Reco raised $30 million in a Series B round led by Zeev Ventures
signals.evidence: Cybersecurity company Reco has raised $30 million in a Series B round led by Oren Zeev’s Zeev Ventures

signals.summary: Reco provides an AI SaaS security platform to secure AI adoption across platforms like Salesforce, ChatGPT, and Copilot
signals.evidence: Reco aims to deliver a purpose-built AI SaaS security platform designed specifically for the AI era, securing AI adoption across Salesforce, ChatGPT, Copilot

signals.summary: CEO Ofer Klein discussed the enterprise shift toward AI consumption through SaaS and Reco's coverage
signals.evidence: "In the enterprise, AI is being consumed through SaaS, whether its AI applications, agents embedded in existing platforms, or AI-powered integrations connecting business systems,"
signals.speaker: Ofer Klein
